properties.entry: SELECT count(*) AS member_count FROM tbl_member WHERE login_id = ?
INSERT INTO tbl_member (grade_code, login_id, password, nickname, phone) VALUES(1, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT member_code, grade_code, login_id, password, nickname, phone, point_balance, total_amount FROM tbl_member WHERE member_code = ?
SELECT grade_name FROM tbl_membership_grade WHERE grade_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET password = ?, nickname = ?, phone = ? WHERE member_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET total_amount = total_amount + ? WHERE member_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET total_amount = GREATEST(total_amount - ?, 0) WHERE member_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET grade_code = CASE WHEN total_amount >= 200000 THEN 3 WHEN total_amount >= 50000 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END WHERE member_code = ?
SELECT msg.reward_rate FROM tbl_member m JOIN tbl_membership_grade msg ON m.grade_code = msg.grade_code WHERE m.member_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET point_balance = point_balance + ? WHERE member_code = ?
UPDATE tbl_member SET point_balance = point_balance - ? WHERE member_code = ? AND point_balance >= ?
